stage.name: Followers
stage.description:
'We will always be together.'
<Originium Pollution> Continuously deals True damage to units on it and greatly reduces their SP recovery.

caustic_originium_slug_enemy_1424_lrboom.name: Caustic Originium Slug
caustic_originium_slug_enemy_1424_lrboom.flavourText: Mutated Originium slugs around Londinium, altered by the rapidly changing environment. Filled with dangerous Originium particulates, their bodies explode upon death, spreading active Originium pollution.
abilities: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and causes Originium pollution.
Increases the strength of an Active Originium Storm when consumed by it.

profane_chimera.name: Profane Chimera
profane_chimera.flavourText: A twisted creation of the Confessarii, this bio-weapon combines multiple pure Sarkaz bloodlines. Originium dust clings to its body, spreading as it flaps its great wings while moving.
abilities: Continuously causes an area of Originium pollution around itself when affected by Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, and attacks deal Arts damage instead.
